2026-11-23.note: Full effort starts today: small exercises to failure, big ones 1 rep before.

pullA:pull-up.coach: Up one step to 35 kg: 30 kg gave 12, above the top of 10.

pullA:cable-row.coach: Stay at 20 kg and go for 12: every set was 10.

pullA:straight-arm-pulldown.coach: Stay at 20 kg and add reps: every set was 12, the top is 15.

pullA:reverse-fly.coach: Drop to 5 kg: 6 reps was far under 12. If the shoulder hurts again, stop and do face pulls.

pullA:cable-lateral.coach: Go lighter: 10 kg gave only 4 to 6. Find a cable that works at 5 kg and start with the left arm.

pullA:curl.coach: Stay at 5 kg with longer rests: sets fell to 7, 6 and 4, aim for 8 on every set.

legsA:leg-press.coach: Empty sled again: aim for 12 on every set, then add the first pair of plates.

legsA:rdl.coach: Stay at 20 kg: the first set gave 6. Get 10 on every set, then step up.

legsA:leg-curl.coach: Stay at 20 kg and add reps: every set was 10, the top is 15.

legsA:leg-extension.coach: Stay at 10 kg, slow: 8 was under 12. Drop it if the spot below the left kneecap hurts.

legsA:standing-calf.coach: Stay at 20 kg and add reps: both sets were 10.

legsA:hanging-knee-raise.coach: Bodyweight again, aim for 12: both sets were 10.

pushB:incline-press.coach: First time: pick a weight you can press 10 times with 2 reps left, the Smith machine is the easiest start.

pushB:shoulder-press.coach: Start at 12.5 kg: 15 kg gave 5, under 8, and 10 kg gave 10.

pushB:db-lateral.coach: Up one step to 4 kg: 3 kg gave 25, over the top of 20.

pushB:dips.coach: First time: bodyweight dips, leaning forward. If 8 do not come, use the chest press machine at a weight for 10.

pushB:overhead-triceps.coach: First time: pick a rope weight you can lift 12 times, lighter than the 25 kg pushdown.

pushB:cable-lateral.coach: Go lighter: 10 kg gave only 4 to 6. Use a cable that works at 5 kg and start with the left arm.

pullB:lat-pulldown.coach: First time: pick a weight for 10 reps. 30 kg gave 12 on Pull A's pulldown, so try about 30 kg.

pullB:chest-supported-row.coach: First time: pick a weight you can row 10 times with 2 reps left.

pullB:one-arm-row.coach: First time: pick a dumbbell you can row 12 times per arm with 2 reps left.

pullB:face-pull.coach: First time: start light, a weight for about 18 reps. Stop if the shoulder hurts.

pullB:cable-lateral.coach: Go lighter: 10 kg gave only 4 to 6. Use a cable that works at 5 kg and start with the left arm.

pullB:hammer-curl.coach: First time: pick dumbbells you can curl 12 times with 2 reps left.

legsB:split-squat.coach: First time: light dumbbells, 10 reps per leg with 2 reps left. Balance first, weight later.

legsB:hip-thrust.coach: First time: pick a weight you can lift 10 times with 2 reps left.

legsB:leg-curl.coach: Stay at 20 kg and add reps, unless Wednesday already gave 15 on every set.

legsB:seated-calf.coach: First time: pick a weight for about 15 slow reps with a pause at the bottom.

legsB:hanging-leg-raise.coach: First time: bodyweight, legs straight, aim for 10. Bend the knees if 10 do not come.

pushA:shoulder-press.coach: Stay at 15 kg for 6 or more: last time gave 5 and 5. If 5 again, drop to 12.5 kg.

pushA:incline-db-press.coach: Stay at 10 kg and add reps: every set was 8, the top is 12.

pushA:cable-lateral.coach: Go lighter: 10 kg gave only 4 to 6. Use a cable that works at 5 kg and start with the left arm.

pushA:chest-fly.coach: Stay at 30 kg: the second set gave 8, under 12.

pushA:triceps-pushdown.coach: Stay at 25 kg and add reps: every set was 10, the top is 15.

pushA:db-lateral.coach: Up one step to 4 kg: 3 kg gave 25, over the top of 20.
